projects.name: XeoTech ERP — Enterprise Business Suite
projects.short_description: Production-style ERP platform built with ASP.NET Core, Clean Architecture, EF Core, SQL Server, and JWT-based security.
projects.description: A full-featured ERP platform designed to centralize core business operations in one system. The backend is built with ASP.NET Core Web API following Clean Architecture, with EF Core and SQL Server for relational persistence, JWT authentication with refresh tokens, repository and unit-of-work abstractions, centralized exception handling, health checks, rate limiting, audit logging, and automated CI. The system covers sales orders and quotes, customers and suppliers, inventory and stock control, payments and invoices, procurement and purchase orders, HR and employees, finance, budgets, expenses, fixed assets, reporting, notifications, and dashboard analytics.
features: Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers
JWT authentication with refresh-token flow and role-based authorization
Sales, orders, quotes, invoices, payments, returns, and receivables workflows
Inventory management with stock validation and low-stock monitoring
Procurement, suppliers, purchase orders, HR, finance, assets, and depreciation modules
Centralized exception handling, audit logging, notifications, and health checks
Dashboard metrics, reporting, CSV/JSON export, and automated CI validation

projects.name: HR System Backend
projects.short_description: Production-style HR management API built with ASP.NET Core and Clean Architecture for secure, maintainable employee workflows.
projects.description: A backend-focused HR management API engineered around Clean Architecture and separation of concerns. The system uses ASP.NET Core, JWT authentication with role-based access control, EF Core persistence, repository abstractions, centralized error handling, secure PBKDF2 password hashing, pagination and search, rate limiting support, health checks, automated CI, and unit tests. The architecture keeps business rules independent from infrastructure while supporting SQL Server for relational deployments and SQLite for local development.
features: Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers
JWT authentication and role-based authorization
Secure PBKDF2 password hashing and authentication workflows
Employee-oriented HR operations with pagination and search
Repository abstractions with EF Core persistence separation
Centralized exception handling, rate limiting, health checks, CI, and tests

projects.name: Smart Real Estate API
projects.short_description: Real-estate backend for property listings, search, bookings, favorites, reviews, and admin moderation using ASP.NET Core and SQL Server.
projects.description: A complete real-estate backend designed around transactional business workflows and role-based access. The API supports property listing management, advanced search and filtering, sale and rent scenarios, booking lifecycle management, favorites, reviews, and admin moderation. It uses ASP.NET Core with EF Core and SQL Server, JWT authentication for User, Vendor, and Admin roles, validated image storage behind an abstraction, centralized exception handling with trace IDs, Swagger/OpenAPI, and Docker Compose for local API and SQL Server development.
features: JWT authentication with User, Vendor, and Admin roles
Property CRUD with admin approval and moderation workflow
Search, filtering, sorting, and page-based pagination
Sale and rental listings with validated property images
Booking lifecycle with pending, confirmed, rejected, and cancelled states
Favorites, reviews, admin dashboard, and user/property administration
SQL Server persistence, EF Core, traceable errors, Swagger, and Docker Compose
